versions.name: Fish and Wildlife Management
versions.description: Find out what threatens fish and wildlife where you live and what managers do about it, then put up nest boxes, build a blind, or improve habitat, and keep records of what shows up.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
